method: 12-tone equal temperament. For scale length L, fret n sits at distance L x (1 - 2^(-n/12)) from the nut, so the 12th fret is exactly L/2 and the 24th fret is L/4; the gap from the previous fret is the difference of successive distances. Results are shown in the entered unit, converting at 25.4 mm per inch, rounded to 0.01 mm or 0.001 in. Scale length is taken as the vibrating string length from the inside face of the nut to the saddle witness point; no saddle compensation, string action, nut height, relief or fret-slot kerf allowance is applied, and positions are theoretical slot centres.
